inlines.v: EL'EGANTLY, adverb In a manner to please; with elegance; with beauty; with pleasing propriety; as a composition elegantly written. 1. With due symmetry; with well formed and duly proportioned parts; as a house elegantly built. 2. Richly; with rich or handsome materials well disposed; as a room elegantly furnished; a woman elegantly dressed.
